items.title: Predictability vs Outcomes

items.title: You Need Tighter WIP Limits With AI
items.excerpt: In a recent class, we were discussing how teams are using AI and finishing coding faster but still missing Sprint Goals. How can these things both be true? That question gets to the heart of a shift many Scrum Teams are experiencing right now. AI has changed the bottleneck. Coding is no longer the constraint it once was. Yet many teams respond by increasing work in progress instead of reducing it. The thinking goes: “We can handle more work now, so let’s pull more in.” The result is pretty predictable. When you work on too many things at once, you end up context switching and delivering value
items.titleJa: AIの時代こそWIP制限を厳格に
items.summaryJa: AIの活用でコーディングが高速化してもスプリントゴール達成に失敗するチームが増加。AIにより開発のボトルネックが変わり、多くのチームが仕掛かり品(WIP)を増やす傾向にあります。しかし実際には、同時進行タスクを減らし、集中度を高めることが重要です。

items.title: Cognitive Trap: Accountability Diffusion
items.excerpt: Accountability Diffusion Trap Most mistakes in Scrum aren’t because people don’t understand the framework—they come from applying reasonable thinking in the wrong context. Cognitive traps happen when decisions favor efficiency, control, or comfort over transparency, inspection, and adaptation. Here is one of ten cognitive traps, Accountability Diffusion. Sharing accountability across multiple people slows decisions and removes the clarity needed for Scrum accountabilities. We'll use Product Owner as the example, since it's the most common accountability where this trap occurs. Simulated Assess
items.titleJa: 認知的罠：アカウンタビリティの拡散

items.title: To Switch, or Not to Switch the AI Model
items.excerpt: TL;DR: The Hidden Cost of Switching AI Models A new AI model arrives that is cheaper per token, scores better on benchmarks, and seems to require nothing more than a setting change. However, the token bill shows only part of the cost of switching AI models. There is also the effort to check whether your workflows, for example, the one to create status reports for stakeholders, still produce outputs in line with your AI Definition of Done. items.titleJa: AIモデルの切り替え判断と隠れたコスト
items.summaryJa: より安価で高性能な新しいAIモデルへの切り替えには、トークンコスト以外の隠れたコストが存在します。ワークフローの動作確認やAIの Definition of Done との整合性検証など、AI Definition of Done との一貫性を確保するための検証作業が必要であり、この検討が切り替え決定と連携していないことが多いです。

items.title: SAFe Didn't Scale Agile. It Scaled Bureaucracy.

It is a design, and its purpose is control, not the creation of value. I have been watching this design operate inside enterprise product teams since 2010, and one of its most successful recent forms wears an Agile badge. items.title: PMO operating models (and how to choose)
items.excerpt: How does your PMO work? As a Project Management Office leader, or someone setting up a PMO, you need to know where the PMO sits in the company, how it’s organized, and what services it offers. This is your operating model. An operating model is different from your staffing model (you could have full-time, part-time or a fractional PMO team). And it’s different from maturity level, which is more about how good your capabilities are. A centralized PMO can be immature; a federated PMO can be highly capable. So what we’re talking about here is how you are setting up your PMO. Your operating model
items.titleJa: PMOの運用モデル選択ガイド

items.title: Your newest team member won’t show up to stand-up: How project managers become agent bosses
items.excerpt: Project managers have been doing the job of the future for decades. Think about what you actually do all day. You don't personally write the code, design the screens, or draft the contracts. You get the right people pointed at the right work, with the right information, at the right time. And then you make sure what comes back is good enough to deliver. That's orchestration. One small thing is different now - some of the "people" you're orchestrating aren't people any more. items.titleJa: 新規チームメンバーがスタンドアップに参加しない時代へ
items.summaryJa: プロジェクトマネージャーの役割がAIエージェントの登場により変容しようとしている。従来のPMは適切な人材を適切な仕事に配置する調整役を担ってきたが、チームメンバーが人間でなくなる新しい現実に対応する必要が生じた。AIエージェントをチーム構成員として統合するPMの新しい課題に直面している。

items.summaryJa: Playwright MCPとCLIのどちらがAI予算を圧迫しているかを比較。12,000個の緑のユニットテストを基準に、両アプローチのコスト効率と実用性を検討し、テスト自動化におけるAI活用の最適な方法を考察する。

items.title: Experts Lead Experts
items.excerpt: We are still early in the journey to learn the long-term impact of AI, but one trend that continues to capture attention is that managers and other leaders will be much less important, and that all we really need are skilled individual contributor builders. We’ve all seen the headlines about companies pushing for fewer managers... The post Experts Lead Experts appeared first on Silicon Valley Product Group.
items.titleJa: エキスパートがエキスパートを導く
items.summaryJa: AIの長期的影響はまだ検証段階だが、組織ではマネージャーの重要性が低下し、スキルの高い個別貢献者が中心となるという傾向が注目を集めている。企業がマネージャー削減を推進する動きが続く中、リーダーシップのあり方が大きく変わろうとしている。

items.title: For Fix Sake
items.excerpt: The latest episode of the Vernon Richard Show, New QA Job? How We'd Decide Where To Start, answers this question from a listener, Shady: When joining a new organisation, how do you decide which QA domino piece to tackle first for the rest to easily fall into place? For example, you might find flaky test automation, poor testability in user stories, no integration tests, limited test management tools, missing test data, and an ever growing regression suite. items.titleJa: 新しい組織でのQA改善、何から始めるべきか
items.summaryJa: 新しい組織に参加した際、フレークなテスト自動化、テスト管理ツールの不足、リグレッション スイートの肥大化など、複数の改善機会がある中で、どの問題を優先して取り組むべきかについて、意思決定のアプローチと優先順位付けの考え方を探る。

items.title: How to communicate the value of your PMO
items.excerpt: When I started out in project management I remember clearly being told that the lifecycle of a PMO was 7 years. It’s often seen as overhead, and certainly I’ve known organizations where the PMO team was caught in reshuffles and redundancies in a way that other teams were not. At least, getting people to believe that the Project Management Office adds value is tricky until something goes wrong, and by then it's too late to build credibility and magic up a PMO when the company has underinvested in it from the start. items.titleJa: PMOの価値をステークホルダーに伝える方法
items.summaryJa: プロジェクトマネジメントオフィス(PMO)は一般にオーバーヘッドと見なされやすく、組織内での信用構築が困難である。PMOの価値を事前に示さないと、経営層の過小投資につながり、危機的状況では信頼を取り戻す時間がない。管理活動の報告だけでなく、PMOが組織にもたらす実質的な価値を効果的に伝える必要がある。

items.title: Responsible Quality Engineering

Also, most “quality engineers” don’t do quality engineering. The people who do quality engineering are developers. items.titleJa: 責任あるクオリティエンジニアリング
items.summaryJa: クオリティエンジニアリングはテストそのものではなく、テストを含む包括的なプロセスである。実際のクオリティエンジニアリングはデベロッパーが主導し、テスターは製品品質の分析とフィードバック提供でそれをサポートする役割を担うべきという考え方を説く。

items.title: The Perfect Job For Me

items.titleJa: 私にとって理想的な仕事
items.summaryJa: 大企業がAIを活用しながらも制御を維持し、収益性を確保し競争力を保つためには、法的・技術的な重大リスクを回避する能力が重要である。AIの進化の行方に関わらず、これはあらゆる大規模企業にとって必須の課題として位置付けられている。
